name: Fishing Gadgets
description: Pocket watch, lunar calendar, climate gauge, depth meter, weather radio, fish finder.

pages.title: Fishing Gadgets
pages.text: The gadgets show the conditions fish care about. Hold one, wear it in a Gadgets slot of the [#](7A3C9A)[Accessories](entry://glossary/curios)[#]() screen, or place the block versions nearby, and its reading shows in the top corner of the screen. Right-click to read it once.

pages.title: Pocket Watch
pages.text: The exact time. A clock and a chain.

pages.title: Lunar Calendar
pages.text: Tonight's moon phase. Paper, an ink sac and a spyglass. Can be placed.

pages.title: Climate Gauge
pages.text: The biome's temperature, which fish care about. Glass, an iron nugget and redstone. Weather and seasons don't change its reading.

pages.title: Depth Meter
pages.text: Your height above or below sea level. Iron ingots, a stick and redstone.

pages.title: Weather Radio
pages.text: When the weather changes next. A lightning rod, redstone and copper. Placed as a block.

pages.title: Fish Finder
pages.text: All five readings at once. Made from all five gadgets.

pages.title: Enchanted Pocket Watch
pages.text: A Pocket Watch and a **Coelacanth**. Right-click a mob to freeze it in place (not bosses); again to free it. 10-second cooldown.
